channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: Companies laying off staff this year includes Amazon, Citi, and Pinterest — see the list
item.description: Layoffs have hit companies including Amazon, Pinterest, and T-Mobile this year as AI and economic conditions reshape the business landscape.

item.title: 'Today' show host Savannah Guthrie's mother Nancy has gone missing. Here's what we know.
item.description: Nancy Guthrie, mother of beloved "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie, has been missing since February 1. Here's what we know about the case.

item.title: Elon Musk will have to sit for a deposition over what he did at DOGE, judge rules
item.description: A judge ruled that Musk could not be considered a high-ranking government official and forgo a deposition.

item.title: Sam Altman says Anthropic's Super Bowl spot is 'dishonest' about ChatGPT ads, but he agrees it's funny
item.description: Sam Altman says Anthropic's Super Bowl ads mocking ChatGPT were funny but that OpenAI would never use advertising the way its depicted.

item.title: American, Chinese, and Russian fighters flew in a rare triple appearance. Here's how their performances compared.
item.description: The biennial Singapore Airshow featured aerobatic stunts from the F-16C, F-35A, Chengdu J-10C, and Su-30MKM.

item.title: Pandora said the price of silver and gold has 'skyrocketed,' and it's betting on another precious metal
item.description: Pandora is launching its best-selling bracelets in platinum plating this year to reduce its reliance on silver.

item.title: I've been traveling across Asia for 10 years. These are the 3 cities with the best food — and one that disappointed me.
item.description: Sophie Steiner says Tokyo is often miscast as the pinnacle of Japanese cuisine. For her, the long waits rarely justify the hype.

item.title: Alibaba's cofounder Joe Tsai shares 2 traits good employees should have
item.description: Alibaba's chairman says ownership and agility are key for innovation success.

item.title: China's tech giants are opening their doors to OpenClaw. The Chinese internet is lapping it up.
item.description: OpenClaw is gaining ground in China as major tech firms add support and users flock to the viral AI agent.

item.title: Miranda Kerr says one thing has helped her co-parent peacefully with ex Orlando Bloom
item.description: "When you have a child with someone else, they're always going to be that person's parent for the rest of their life," Miranda Kerr said.
